body.text:
# Goals

Keep specs, plans and decisions in the repository as records
that agents can find from the task they are working on.

# IDs and addresses

A relic ID is `<KEY>-R-<ULID>`. A part is `<relic>#<part>`.

# When two edits meet

Two saves of one body are never merged. The second is refused
or reported as a conflict, and nothing is lost.

fields.title: Relics live under their own refs

body.text: Each relic is one ref under `refs/workbook/relics/`.
A save names the version it started from with `--base`.

fields.title: How large may one body grow?

body.text: One MiB for now; revisit once relics hold real designs.
